description: Details helps you find curated website design references, inspect images and ordered video frames, and retrieve reusable web interface resources from the Details Vault. Search by section, component, style, or interaction, compare numbered results, then inspect a selected reference or retrieve a resource's implementation instructions and documentation. A connected Details account with an eligible plan is required; available tools and usage allowances depend on your account.
